exams.name: Oral and written examination (tier 1)
exams.notes: Tests basic language fluency, basic medical terminology, basic cultural competency, knowledge of national standards of practice, and understanding of medical confidentiality requirements including HIPAA.
exams.jurisdiction: administered by the division, a person under contract with the division, a national certification organization, or a person approved by the division by rule
exams.quote: passes an oral and written examination: (i) administered by: (A) the division; (B) a person under contract with the division; (C) a national certification organization; or (D) a person approved by the division by rule

exams.name: Written examination (tier 2)
exams.notes: Tier 2 applies only when an oral examination is not available in the language for which the individual applies.
exams.jurisdiction: administered by the division, a person under contract with the division, a national certification organization, or a person approved by the division by rule
exams.quote: If an oral examination under Subsection (1)(b) is not available in the language for which an individual applies for certification, the individual may qualify as a tier 2 certified medical language interpreter if the individual passes the written portion of an examination under Subsection (1)(b)

interval_years.quote: the division shall issue each certification under this chapter in accordance with a three-year renewal cycle established by rule.

available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct which is detrimental to the interests of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct which is detrimental to the interests of the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or negligent betrayal or disclosure of confidential information obtained through the practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful or negligent betrayal or disclosure of confidential information about which the certified medical language interpreter becomes knowledgeable as a result of or incidental to the certified medical language interpreter's practice as a certified medical language interpreter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: False or deceptive representation of skills, competence, capability, or resources.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: false or deceptive representation of a certified medical language interpreter's skills, competence, capability, or resources as a certified medical language interpreter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or agreeing to undertake an assignment for which the interpreter is not qualified or cannot complete professionally.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering, undertaking, or agreeing to undertake an assignment as a certified medical language interpreter for which the certified medical language interpreter is not qualified or which the certified medical language interpreter cannot complete as agreed in a professional manner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of chemicals, drugs, or alcohol in an unlawful manner or in a manner that negatively affects competence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the use of any chemical, drug, or alcohol in any unlawful manner or in any manner which negatively affects the ability of the certified medical language interpreter to competently practice as a certified medical language interpreter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and intentionally making any false or fraudulent interpretation, statement, or representation in the performance of duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully and intentionally making any false or fraudulent interpretation, statement, or representation in the performance of the certified medical language interpreter's duties;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct contrary to the recognized standards and ethics of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any conduct contrary to the recognized standards and ethics of the profession of a certified medical language interpreter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross incompetence in practice as a certified medical language interpreter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross incompetence in practice as a certified medical language interpreter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rules promulgated to regulate the practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any provision of this chapter or rules promulgated to regulate the practice of certified medical language interpreters;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any other crime considered detrimental to the public interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony or any other crime which is considered by the division to represent activity detrimental to the public interest as that interest is reflected in the person continuing to practice as a certified medical language interpreter.

definition_quote.value: "Medical language interpreter" means a person who, for compensation, performs verbal language interpretation services between a health care provider who speaks English and another person for the purpose of assisting the person in seeking or obtaining medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Medical language interpreter" means a person who, for compensation, performs verbal language interpretation services between a health care provider who speaks English and another person for the purpose of assisting the person in seeking or obtaining medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment.

value: basic medical terminology including body parts, internal organs, symptoms, dosage amounts and frequency
basic cultural competency relating to medical care beliefs and practices
knowledge and understanding of the national standards of practice
basic understanding of medical confidentiality requirements including HIPAA
exam_content_areas.quote: that tests: (A) basic language fluency with respect to the language for which the individual applies for certification; (B) basic medical terminology with respect to the language for which the individual applies for certification, including the ability to name human body parts, name internal human organs, describe basic medical symptoms, and describe basic medical instructions, including dosage amounts and frequency; (C) basic cultural competency relating to medical care beliefs and practices that are common to people who speak the language for which the individual applies for certification; (D) knowledge and understanding of the national standards of practice; and (E) a basic understanding of medical confidentiality requirements, including the confidentiality requirements of the federal Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act;

national_standards_adherence_required.quote: signs a statement agreeing to abide by the national standards of practice;
